name: brightside-logs
description: Read Brightside's local rolling application logs to investigate startup, venue, adapter, model, network or UI errors. Load only for log-based diagnostics; access is read-only.

content.inline:
# Brightside logs

Call `file_roots` and select the root whose live description identifies Brightside's operational logs. List its files by modification time and stat a candidate before reading it.

Logs may contain stack traces, local paths and operation names. The file tool has no range or tail mode, so do not pull a multi-megabyte log into context; report when bounded log-tail support is needed. Correlate timestamps and identifiers with job or session evidence. This skill contributes only roots, list, stat and read operations.
